description: The bar chart illustrates the number of tasks for different language groups, with the horizontal axis representing the number of tasks and the vertical axis listing the language groups. The x-axis is linear, ranging from 0 to 80, with tick labels at intervals of 10. The y-axis contains eight categories: IE-Slavic, IE-Romance, IE-Germanic, Uralic, IE-Baltic, IE-other, IE-Indic, Semitic, Turkic, and Basque. The bars are color-coded and vary in length, indicating the number of tasks for each language group. IE-Slavic has the highest number of tasks, close to 80, while Basque has the fewest, around 5.
